title: Minner Pickaxe
description: Mine faster with the Minner Pickaxe! Features Auto Smelt, Fortune III, and Efficiency III built in. Instantly smelt ores, turn sand into glass, and gather more resources with every block you mine.
body:
⚒️ Minner Pickaxe is a powerful Hoplite and Smelter's Pickaxe-inspired Plugin designed to make resource gathering faster and more rewarding.

![Minner Pickaxe Crafting Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a5b9c1516dd541da59d8c11d1f3ae92585e7f88d.png)
Features:
- ✔ Auto Smelt all smeltable ores instantly
- ✔ Fortune III built in for extra drops
- ✔ Efficiency III built in for faster mining
- ✔ Automatically smelts sand into glass
- ✔ Works on servers and singleplayer
- ✔ Saves fuel and furnace time
  
Stop wasting time smelting ores manually. With Minner Pickaxe, every mining trip becomes faster, more rewarding, and more efficient. Mine iron, gold, copper, and other ores and receive the smelted version instantly while benefiting from Fortune III drops.

Perfect for Survival, SMPs, Lifesteal Servers, and Hoplite-style gameplay.

Download now and upgrade your mining experience!
